_help: Images for the pages the book leaves blank (from the CV onward). 'pages' maps a blank page's label to its image; any blank page not listed picks from 'default'. Labels: after:<id> is the blank page right after the part/section with that id, before:<id> the one right before it. Open book.html and look in the browser console: each blank page logs its label. Per-page options: image (path, or "none" to leave it blank), zoom (percent, bigger = tighter crop, e.g. 400), x and y (0-100, which part of the image sits on the page). Only image is required.
